title: Wi-Fi Coverage Simulator - Neemba CAT Togo
tagline: Standalone web simulator to visualise and optimise Wi-Fi coverage on a floor plan.
description: I built a simulator to plan Wi-Fi coverage for Neemba Togo’s offices, workshops and hangars. I can place access points on a plan, annotate walls, compare scenarios and export a PDF report.
features: RSSI heatmap computed in real time on the site plan
Interactive placement of access points: add, move, rename and delete
Manual wall annotation by material, with radio attenuation taken into account
Import of image plans with scale calibration in pixels per metre
Editable catalogue of access point models with AI-assisted search
RSSI analysis by critical business zone
PDF export of the simulation, statistics and visual recommendations
challenges: I combined a radio propagation model and wall annotations in a standalone tool. The challenge was to make simulations useful for planning while keeping the need for field validation in mind.
learnings: I deepened my knowledge of Canvas and geometry calculations. This project also helped me understand the differences between radio simulations and real conditions.
